component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("sceneObsTaskWrite", "onSceneObserved") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onSceneObserved(event as object) print "SCENE OBSERVER " + event.getField() + "=" + event.getData().toStr() end sub
sub onReady() m.task.runObsRenderWrite = 3 end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
